fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-08-03 states that a message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 15,000 was transferred out, on 2025-08-02 at about 09:55. Kannan Muthu submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000430. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100035. A further person, Dinesh Balan, an intermediary, using the number 9000000363, is stated to be associated with the incident. An unidentified caller using the number 9000000318 was mentioned in the complaint. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00131, as the mobile number 9000000318 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, receiving account, associate, morning, residential colony, mobile number
